The name of the "time field" on the registration form. Periodically changing this field may help fight against the smarter spambots out there. Keep this field simple; alpha-numeric only.

Should XenForo fail to connect to the database, a user will automatically be approved for registration. Otherwise they will be rejected and told to try registering again later.

If you disable the challenging of usernames, only emails and IP addresses will be challenged. Advanced warning however: make sure you do not use the "Low" heuristic option, as it would mathematically be impossible to match 3 challenges; since only 2 challenges will be issued.
How many days to give a new user to confirm their email address before automatically deleting their account. Periodic emails will automatically be sent out. (0 to disable)
